_about: Role life facts used to keep daily details consistent. Copy to facts.json. Canonical structure is {facts, user_facts, life} (see docs/configuration.md); the themed sections at the bottom are the legacy fallback form and are only read when the facts field is absent.
_about_facts: Canonical role-fact list (strings). worker.py reads THIS list first; keep all durable role facts here.
_about_life: Life-generation pools. worker.py life_config() replaces its built-in neutral defaults key by key with whatever is set here (moods/schedules are keyed by busy level: low/mid/high). Values below are neutral examples - replace with your persona's own.
_about_life_circle: life.circle / life.habits / life.routine: the persona's social circle, daily rituals and workday/rest-day routine skeleton. life.py samples a daily life plan (state/life_today.json) from them for the organic proactive engine and the daily brief. Same keys may also live in persona.json life; facts wins per key.
_about_people: life.people: core people (by the name/word the persona uses for them) for people-aware daily events and quiet checks. Use generic role words, not real persons' names.
_about_themed_sections: Legacy/fallback form: themed string arrays (home_and_daily / work / food / ...). They are flattened and used ONLY when facts is absent. When facts exists they are ignored, so do not maintain facts in both places - the strings below mirror the facts list above purely as a format example.
_about_user_facts: Facts about the USER (the person chatting), newest/most important first. Entries are strings, or objects {fact, status} where status defaults to active; non-active entries are skipped.
